method: Run-length transects using production MountainRidges with vanilla Xoroshiro ridge/offset seeds. Incomplete boundary runs excluded. Both horizontal axes sampled.
interpretation: The latest user preference retains more snowy taiga and favors doubling the horizontal Perlin scale. The full ridge and domain-shift noise coordinates are divided by two; weirdness values are not remapped and vertical amplitude remains vanilla. Mean widths are 1.88, 1.93, and 2.00 times the corresponding vanilla sub-band widths. The two low sub-bands are not each as wide as the former combined central band.
coverage_tradeoff: Snowy taiga covers 33.28% of this sample versus vanilla's 32.64%, replacing the earlier 1.82% width-priority profile. All three bands widen together, including taiga. Finite transects differ slightly because they sample different portions of a noise domain; these are statistical widths, not guarantees for individual contours.
